verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an official MCP server, Agent Skills, a plugin for AI coding agents, and API access via service accounts, but nothing describes an official SigNoz command-line tool. These are adjacent agent and API integrations, not a CLI. An observability platform could reasonably ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
